issues.issue: Did the Officer breach procedural fairness by not taking further steps to alert the applicant of missing documents and allowing an opportunity to respond?
issues.applicant_position: Officer should have alerted applicant and allowed chance to respond, especially as unrepresented; rigid processing with minimal communication.
issues.respondent_position: Communication was sent; risk of non-delivery rests with applicant; no failure indicated; applicant failed to submit documents.
issues.result_text: Duty of procedural fairness satisfied; applicant bears risk of miscommunication as email was sent and no proof of non-receipt.

issues.issue: Was the Officer required to consider the best interests of the applicant's child in the decision?
issues.applicant_position: Best interests of child should have been considered; humanitarian and compassionate factors apply to Live-in Caregiver applications.
issues.respondent_position: No request for humanitarian and compassionate consideration was made; Officer had no duty to advise applicant to seek exemption.
issues.result_text: No request made; Officer not required to consider best interests of child absent such request.
